title: Nice for toast and other small items, but that's about it.
text: Nice for toast and other small items, but that's about it.. This toaster oven is great for making toast.  It's too small to use as a rotisserie oven.  Tried a small chicken in it and it didn't fit.  It was tied up and still kept hitting the sides.  You could possibly do a cornish hen in it.  The pan doesn't hold enough liquid for a whole chicken either.  It overflows and make a mess.  This is a nice little oven for warming things, but forget the rotisserie part.  The outside gets very hot.  I would not buy this oven again. I would get a bigger one.

It boasts both beauty and function with its elegant Black Stainless Steel panels and features like convection and Rotisserie cooking.
